summary.intent: Design decisions for a memory system feature covering keyword matching behavior, editable fields, and injection threshold controls.
summary.outcome: Three design decisions were locked in: keywords boost (not replace) token-overlap scoring; only title/body/keywords are user-editable (not kind/scope/confidence/strength); threshold uses named presets with individual override escapes. Approach 3 (TUI + $EDITOR handoff for body) was recommended for the edit UX.

repo: Memory records have fields including title, body, why, keywords, kind, scope, confidence, and strength.
Injection scoring uses a scoreRecord() function with token-overlap matching on title+body.
History events (HistoryEvent) track changes with before/after diffs.
The TUI dashboard uses a wizard pattern with actions like suppress/archive; huh forms are used for inline editing.

code.finding: File was modified during the session, likely where the Edit action and related TUI changes were prototyped or scaffolded.

workflow: Design Q&A style (multiple choice with lettered options) was used to drive architecture decisions incrementally before moving to implementation approaches.
Pros/cons were explicitly requested before making a choice on the editable-fields question, indicating the user wants tradeoff visibility before committing.
Approach selection used a recommended option with explicit rationale, not just a list.

friction: Inline huh forms for multi-line body text are clunky in a terminal — noted as a trade-off of TUI-only editing.
CLI-only editing (Approach 2) would split UX and require users to know memory IDs, which was flagged as a usability problem.
open_items: Implementation of Approach 3 (TUI + $EDITOR handoff) is not yet done — only the approach was selected.
Keyword boost multiplier value (e.g., 3x) is a placeholder; final tuning not decided.
Specific threshold preset values (evidence sessions required, minimum strength, generic filter strictness) not yet defined.
Reconciliation behavior when generator refreshes a memory that has user-edited fields needs to be resolved.
CLI subcommand `entire memory-loop threshold <preset>` mentioned for scriptability but not scoped into the plan yet.
